subject: SUMMARY encode-cpu-opus (03:30): commit-ready set + what is blocked
body: Commit-ready (mine only; overlay-verified on git HEAD + my hunks, shared tree currently broken by others: nord2_render_pass.inc n2r_rt_load_exact undeclared, render harness blit invalid assert, api-surface test 'Text file busy'): (1) translator patch gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/translator-compile-speed-combined.patch 2a732933 in both pin checkouts (const_loads fold + metered decode reuse + fingerprint memo): census 3456 variants 0 behaviour/code-size changes, -28% compile wall; c6l projection fixed_frag miss ~1.2 s -> ~0.12-0.18 s. Commit both checkouts + bump PIN. (2) air_bridge.rs device_for_profile (ov_ab.patch), build_air_bridge.py fat LTO. (3) compute_frontend.m P2/P1 (scheduled at submission for pipelined commands, depth-2 throttle, early_wait/early_forced in TEGU_PERF_FRAME); ship with -DTEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE_DEFAULT=1. (4) render_pipeline.inc plan memo: 16 ways, light pre-hash, vertex-count and 2D-extent canonical keys (exactness audited; host verify 0 mismatches), variant memo 8 ways; render_encoder.inc TEGU_PERF_PLANMISS line (ov_memo.patch d7b22e7c). (5) test build/encode-cpu-20261026/async_frontend_test.py. Artifacts built earlier (rebuild at C6m): host cdylib, host Mali 2430cc80, iOS libtegu_air_bridge.a a64b9c4b (LTO), libNord2Mali.a ecc08e83. Not done / reasons: background compile at creation (Metal creation must report failure synchronously; draw-time Mali variants depend on bound formats; ansuz's background compile is their not-yet-used native path + prewarm = our packs), FunctionCompileKey reuse (needs a second specialization per miss; no translator compile-with-entries API), WC wide copies (all bridge CPU maps are kIOMapDefaultCache), buffer-offset memo canonicalization (needs TEGU_PERF_PLANMISS offset numbers from the next device run first).
